meta.jcs_implementation: Self-implemented: recursive key-sorted clone (UTF-16 code unit order) followed by native JSON.stringify, relying on V8 already implementing RFC 8785-compatible ECMA-262 number/string serialization for the JSON-integer-only, ASCII-plus-escaped-control-char content used throughout these vectors. See the comment block in scripts/gen-vectors.mjs for the full justification.
meta.signature_algorithm: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) via node:crypto (WebCrypto algorithm identifier "Ed25519"; NODE-ED25519 is not used)

vectors.title: 轮换连续性签名链(三代密钥)

cases.description: Generation 2 key continuity signature, signed by generation-1 private key.
Generation 3 key continuity signature, signed by generation-2 private key.
Event signed by retired generation-1 key, verified while now_ms <= retired_at + Q. MUST accept (docs §2.4/§6.3).

body.text: signed by a key that is now retired

cases.description: MUST-fail: same signature as TV-08c, but verified after now_ms > retired_at + Q. The Ed25519 signature itself is still cryptographically valid; rejection is a key-lifecycle policy decision (OMEW_KEY_UNKNOWN per docs §2.4), not a signature failure.

body.text: signed by a key that is now retired

cases.description: seq = 2^53 - 1 (Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER), the protocol-mandated ceiling. MUST accept.

MUST-fail: seq = 2^53, one past the protocol ceiling of 2^53-1. Even though correctly signed (the Ed25519 signature below verifies), the envelope MUST still be rejected at the field-validation layer because the protocol range check is "abs(value) <= 2^53-1", not "is exactly representable as a double" -- signature validity alone is not sufficient for acceptance.

representability_demo.note: Constructing 2^53+1 via raw JSON text and parsing it back demonstrates the representability cliff that motivates the +/-(2^53-1) ceiling: values above the ceiling can silently change value across independent JCS producers/consumers.

vectors.title: user.moved 双路径信封:dual_sign 含嵌套 home_release 验签、disaster 含公示期与异议冻结

cases.description: Nested home_release: A's own signed user.update envelope with moved_to=new, evidence only (not a delivered event).
user.moved, mode=dual_sign, broadcast by new home c.example, carrying a verified nested home_release from a.example.
user.moved, mode=disaster (no home_release): recorded pending, effective_at = ts + 7d.
user.move_objection from old home a.example, target_id matches the disaster user.moved, arrives within the 7d notice window.

MUST-fail (state-machine, not signature): a second disaster-path migration proof for the same `old` actor, submitted after a matching, in-window user.move_objection was recorded, MUST be rejected 409 OMEW_MIGRATION_FROZEN regardless of signature validity.
